_purpose: Recorded state of the visual authority and the modules measured against it. Drift is not automatically wrong - the owner may change their own module - but it MUST be surfaced, because silently re-baselining would make 'matches Inventory' unfalsifiable.
_algorithm: aggregate = sha256( concat( '<repo-relative-path>:<sha256-of-file>\n' ) for files matching glob, sorted by ordinal path )
_reblessing: Re-blessing is a deliberate act by the module owner, in a DEDICATED commit, never bundled with a feature change.

inventory-shell.note: The shell every governed module renders through.

brand-stylesheet.note: Ledger green + gold. The one file allowed to define brand design tokens.

tasks-views.note: 8 views, all on the authority shell at record time.

calendar-views.note: 3 views, all on the authority shell at record time.
